name: Task Shader Block-wise Stream Compaction
aliases: Task Shader Cell Classification and Task Generation
definition: A custom occlusion culling pass determines a potentially visible set (PVS) of blocks to avoid extracting geometry for blocks not visible in the display. This reduces the number of task shader workgroups launched.
summary: Task Shader Block-wise Stream Compaction is a GPU-driven occlusion culling technique that identifies volume blocks containing isosurface geometry and generates proxy geometry to determine the potentially visible set of blocks.
